title: Audition and rehearsal that won him Webb's trumpet chair
summary: He auditions among many trumpeters and Webb rehearses him alone for three nights, insisting he is the man.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: it don't cost you nothing to go. In fact the man told me to tell you to go. So I said, all right, I'm going, sure.

I got there. There was about ten, 15, 20 trumpet players. Every -- these guys play maybe half a tune, a tune. This guy and all right -- so come my time, he say, who's to come in there -- say, INDIAN! in there, come in; it's your turn. So I start playing. I play (inaudible). He say, I want you to work tonight with me. I say, all right. So 10:00 o'clock we start. All right.

So I got in the Savoy that night. I'm nervous. I play, play all night. And so he said, you know, we're going to have rehearsal right after the job. You got half an hour to go and buy yourself a sandwich, you know. You come back. We're going to start rehearsal.

All right. So when I got back, I looked for the guys. Where's the guys? He said, no, never mind the guys, rehearsal for you. I said, for me? I never seen no rehearsal for one man (inaudible) that's the way I do with you. All right.

So he say, take such and such a number out. I took the number out. He said, play. He said, don't phrase that like that. So he used to hum to me the way he wanted me to phrase. I try. I said keep going. No. Like that -- I had good ideas.
So when we got through rehearsal about 5:00 o'clock

in the morning, I say, I don't think I'm the man, you know, to do what you got, what you need. You need a man here with experience. No, if you listen to me, you're the man I want. So all right. I come back to work the next day. Same thing. I say, Chick, I don't think I'm the man. I don't want to hold you back. You know what I mean? I appreciate you giving me this opportunity, but I don't want to hold you back. He said, no, no, no, no, you listen to me. All right. So by the third day, he say, the job is yours. So just listen to me, and that's that. I said all right.
So I begin to QUALMATE (inaudible) the man so much, and the music was so -- nothing around, not for me --
